_description: Inflation-indexed federal tax brackets — Traditional-only drawdown with 3% inflation. Verifies that bracket/deduction thresholds inflate in years > 2026, reducing bracket creep.
_rationale: 2M Traditional, 80k/yr fixed spending (not inflation-adjusted), 0% return, 3% inflation, single, Florida. Year 2026 (index 0): factor=1.0, deduction=$16,100, no senior deduction (age 60). Analytical: tax ≈ $11,244. Year 2036 (index 10): factor=1.03^10≈1.3439, deduction inflates to ~$21,637 (standard) + $2,755 (senior, age 70) = $24,392. Inflated 12% bracket top = $67,733. Tax ≈ $7,204 — about $3,460 less than frozen-bracket tax (~$10,665). This delta proves inflation indexing is active.
name: Bracket Inflation Test
